**ACCEPT** — reviewer of record: spec seat R8, `session_012xGvxcwPRTJfA7RfjXEYA4`. PR: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12611 (draft, head `16a65fd84`, 7 files).

Checked against the PR itself: union widened to exactly nine members with the closed-union doc updated in place (#9384 posture restated); one ledger row under `@objectstack/runtime` with the required TSDoc justification covering never-dispatched semantics, 422 mapping (as `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`, deliberately distinct), non-retryability grounded in the guard being a pure function of the definition, NOT-a-VALIDATION_ERROR rationale, and the registered-ahead-of-producer design (#10413→#10576 shape). Tests pin both halves — the contract literal compiles (the #9384 reverse verification run forward) with `status` asserted absent, and the ledger pins the exact string by value plus `standardSynonymOf === undefined` (no waiver needed). Generated `contract.mdx` / `error-code-ledger.mdx` regenerated (+289→+290, code in both alphabetical lists). Changeset is **minor** — a deliberate, correct divergence from this round's patch precedents: an additive public vocabulary member is a feature, and the ruled operator-visible consequence is stated plainly as the ruling requires. The declared decision on `flow-dispatch-status.ts` is accepted: measured (no gate or type-coherence requires the row; dispatcher-vocabulary gate runs producers→registration; full suite green without it), so the row stays with #10025's services half per the recorded split, now transcribing three spec-recorded contract inputs instead of minting them.

**Sequencing note recorded on #10025 (not a defect here):** the hand-written refusal tables at `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx:~1383` and `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:~720-740` enumerate trigger-refusal codes by name — the `FLOW_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID` rows belong there only WHEN the engine starts stamping it, i.e. in the services half's PR; adding them in this contract-only PR would have been docs-side declared≠enforced. Correctly not done.

Clause-② enqueue gate: path limb fires (contracts + error-code-ledger — the ledger is named in the gate's own path list) AND declaration limb yes; dispatch tier `claude-fable-5` = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` — satisfied. Landing path: ready → merge queue once every check on `16a65fd84` is green; this seat watches to MERGED, then #10025's unlock scan fires.
